item.description: “The vast majority of cases we find are people who are entitled to claim for something, claiming for that thing,” the researcher told TechCrunch.

item.description: Listen Labs walked away from a signed Series C term sheet from Menlo Ventures, sources say.

item.title: Apple Watch’s new AI features are normalizing the idea that technology is always listening
item.description: Apple says its new watches won’t save raw audio, but features that can transcribe recent speech and summarize ambient conversations raise new questions about consent, privacy, and how people behave when they know they could always be recorded.

item.description: The update uses Apple Intelligence to make better sense of your health data.

item.title: Apple has a new way to prove your iPhone photos aren’t AI slop

item.title: Apple CEO John Ternus says the best AI device is still the iPhone
item.description: The company also argued that its on-device models offer consumers more privacy.

item.title: Superintelligence is coming. Should we let it?
